concept

“Seasonal Flavours, Memorable Moments”

Welcome to FIORASERA, a table set for the pleasure of Italian dining.

The colours of the season, the fragrance of a freshly prepared dish, and the quiet anticipation of the next course.

We imagine a table where thoughtful flavours and the warmth of Italian hospitality come together.

Pasta, seasonal dishes and unhurried conversation, shared in an intimate dining room.

Gather with those who matter to you, and enjoy a moment to remember.

message

I believe cooking begins with listening to the ingredients. Entrusted with the gifts of land and sea, I strive to bring out their character and serve each at its very best.

Taking time. Paying attention to the heat, to every small detail. That is the work I return to each day. For the quiet smile at the table, I will always give my best in the kitchen.

Chef / FIORASERA

courses

SOLELunch · 4 courses

A four-course lunch with a starter, pasta, a main course and dessert. A gentle introduction to the flavours of the season.

¥13,000per guest · tax & service included

NATURALELunch · 5 courses

A five-course lunch featuring ravioli, fish and grilled pork. Take time to savour the ingredients and their changing seasons.

¥18,000per guest · tax & service included

ColtivareDinner · 5 courses

A five-course dinner, from marinated striped marlin and ravioli to fish and lamb. A journey through honest Italian flavours.

¥25,000per guest · tax & service included

STAGIONEDinner · 6 courses

A six-course dinner with scallop carpaccio, crab tagliolini, white tilefish and Akaushi beef. A celebration of seasonal ingredients.

¥33,000per guest · tax & service included

    Privacy Policy

    This FIORASERA demo explains how information entered into its contact and recruitment form is handled.

    1. Purpose of Use

    This form demonstrates the contact and recruitment experience. You can try entering the following types of inquiry:

    • Reservations and visits
    • Questions about the restaurant
    • Recruitment enquiries
    2. Management of Personal Information

    Information entered in this form is not sent outside the page or saved by this website. Please use fictional information when trying the form.

    3. Prohibition of Disclosure to Third Parties

    This demo does not collect the information entered into the form and does not disclose or provide it to third parties.

    • Inquiry details are not sent to an external service.
    • The verification control does not connect to an external service.
    4. Inquiries by the Individual

    As this demo does not save information entered into the form, it does not accept requests to access, correct or delete stored information. Details of any live service will be provided when available.

    5. Contact Us

    The submit button displays a notice that links are not configured for this demo. No inquiries or recruitment applications are accepted through this form.
